videos.title: Zechariah 2: Who Sent Yahweh?
videos.hook: An unanswered challenge about Yahweh being sent by Yahweh of Hosts. End before the caller answers.

videos.title: Atheist Investigates the First Mover Argument
videos.hook: Use the user-selected setup-and-payoff: atheist searches for arguments, then calls this one pretty good while remaining uncertain. The first extract is shortened to retain approximately 20 seconds of spoken dialogue; validate audio pacing.

videos.title: Does the Quran Contradict Earlier Scripture?
videos.hook: The critic of Islam argues that the Quran instructs people to judge by earlier revelation, then allegedly fails its own test. End on the opponent requesting an example.

videos.title: Did Islam Preserve the Entire Quran?
videos.hook: The caller challenges the evidence, prepares to leave, and is asked whether he wants to see the hadith. End on his acceptance of the challenge.

videos.title: Can God Enter His Creation?
videos.hook: The caller claims God would be bound by time if he entered creation; the exchange becomes tense when Elijah attempts to repeat his point.

videos.title: Can Christians Lose Salvation?
videos.hook: A dialogue on whether sins that distance someone from God put salvation at risk. End before the distinction is resolved.

videos.title: Did Jesus Claim the Divine Name?
videos.hook: The John 8 debate turns on Jesus saying I AM before Abraham. Feature the question about why the crowd sought to stone him.

videos.title: Can God Be Both Perfectly Merciful and Perfectly Just?
videos.hook: Use the question-and-answer about justice and mercy, ending on the problem of what a just judge must do.

videos.title: Was Muhammad Prophesied in the Bible?
videos.hook: The Muslim argues Muhammad is prophesied in the Bible. Elijah challenges the consistency of relying on the Bible while rejecting its other teachings.

videos.title: Did Daniel Predict the Messiah Before AD 70?
videos.hook: A date-sensitive messianic prophecy challenge is introduced from Daniel 9, concluding with the AD 70 deadline.

videos.title: Does the Quranic Roman Victory Prophecy Work?
videos.hook: The callers dispute whether the Roman victory described by the Quran fits 622 CE; end with their competing readings unresolved.
